summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.1 (Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package) end-to-end, including debugging and fixing integration issues discovered during the Plan 19.1-05 checkpoint verification of the web app's SDK rewiring.
summary.outcome: Plans 19.1-01 through 19.1-05 completed with 10 atomic fix commits. 9/10 verified operations passing (create/rename folder, upload/download/edit/rename/move/delete file); delete-to-bin fixed and confirmed working via Playwright. Plan 19.1-06 (final cleanup/release) not yet started.

repo: @cipherbox/api-client generated functions require setApiClientConfig() to be called at runtime before use — this must happen during SDK initialization in useAuth.ts, not at module load time
FolderEntry.id is a UUID used for UI navigation/store lookup; folder.ipnsName (k51...) is the IPNS identifier — these must not be conflated when writing to the Zustand store
SDK's CipherBoxClient.loadBin() previously returned null on fresh accounts (no IPNS record yet), causing deleteToBin() to fall back to hard deleteItem() silently
IPNS sequence number 409 conflicts occur when two independent code paths (SDK + old service) both write to the same IPNS records — only one writer per IPNS name is safe
The ensureFolderRegistered bridge in sdk-provider.ts is fragile: syncing children/seqNum/ipnsPrivateKey from Zustand store overwrites SDK's more up-to-date internal state after SDK mutations
Per-file IPNS metadata (v2 format) requires the parent folder's folderKey for decryption — download paths that bypass this (old ipns.service.ts) cannot decrypt v2 files
Web3Auth OTP rate limit is enforced in Redis at 5 sends per 15 minutes — can be cleared with redis-cli DEL on the rate limit key for dev testing
The test-login endpoint uses secret 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production' and is available in the local dev environment for SDK integration tests

code.finding: loadBin() now returns an empty BinState (not null) when no IPNS record exists yet, mirroring the old service's initializeBin() behavior. This is required for deleteToBin() to work on fresh accounts.
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish retries once on 409 by re-resolving the IPNS sequence number via resolveIpnsRecord. This handles stale seq numbers from concurrent writers or IPNS cache lag.

Two critical init calls: (1) setApiClientConfig() with baseUrl + getAccessToken must be called before any SDK IPNS operations; (2) client.loadBin() must be called AFTER initializeBin() completes (old service creates the bin IPNS record first).
ensureFolderRegistered should skip entirely if client.hasFolder(ipnsName) — overwriting SDK state after SDK mutations causes sequence number and private key corruption.

Upload must go through client.uploadFile() (SDK path), not the old two-step service. The old service increments IPNS seq numbers outside SDK awareness, making subsequent SDK mutations fail with 409 or 'Item not found'.

SDK integration test uses test-login endpoint for auth, validates full lifecycle (folder create/upload/download/rename/delete/bin) against live local API. IPNS delegated routing retries cause ~30s runtime — expected and acceptable.

workflow: Validate SDK-level fixes with integration tests against the live API before attempting UI verification — much faster feedback loop and eliminates UI/auth noise
When two code paths write to the same IPNS record, the only stable fix is eliminating one path — syncing state between them always creates new edge cases
Playwright MCP headed session is the right tool for UI verification; driving via scripts (playwright CLI) introduces its own selector/timing bugs that obscure the real failures
Random email per E2E test run ensures clean filesystem state and avoids cross-test pollution from IPNS records
Atomic commits per logical fix (not per file) make bisecting and review tractable when multiple interrelated bugs are fixed in one session
When the web app uses SDK packages via workspace, 'pnpm build' on the package + Vite HMR picks up changes without a full server restart — but page reload is needed for init-time code (useAuth hooks)

friction: Web3Auth OTP rate limiting (5/15min) blocked Playwright login attempts during rapid iteration — required Redis cache clearing
Vite dev server HMR doesn't reload init-time hooks (useAuth) — required full page navigations to test SDK init fixes
mcp__playwright__browser_file_upload failed silently when the file path wasn't in an allowed directory; required creating test files in the project directory
IPNS delegated routing retries cause 25-30s latency in integration tests, making iterative test runs slow
duplicate key constraint in auth table for the test email blocked login mid-session — required switching to a fresh random email
The 'classifyHandoffIfNeeded' Claude Code runtime bug caused spurious agent failure reports, requiring spot-check verification to distinguish real failures from false negatives
pnpm dev was killed between context windows, requiring server restart and new OTP flow before Playwright verification could continue
